angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 640,044 km at 52.38 pc = 0.16 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 19.0911 +/- 0.0125 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 52.38 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.92 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Brinkman et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1011 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..109B/abstract): 640,044 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.91 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Brinkman et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1011 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..109B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5475 +/- 84 K from Brinkman et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1011 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..109B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Brinkman et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1011 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..109B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1011.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.470, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1011 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.03 dex, from Brinkman et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..109B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1011 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.1549, from Brinkman et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..109B/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5592015297342611968, flags_flame 00: age_flame 9.071643 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 3.4155555 to 13.233097)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, HD 61051: projected rotation speed 3 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
